newsitem.headline: TABLE - Summit Properties sells debt.

text.p: The following three-tranche debt issue from Summit Properties Inc was priced on Thursday, according to lead manager JP Morgan Securities Inc.
Summit is a self-run REIT, develops, builds, owns, manages apartment properties.
